name: Claude for Microsoft 365
desc: Claude add-ins for Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook
desc_zh: 可在 Excel、PowerPoint 与 Outlook 里协作的 Claude 插件
solves: Analysis lives in a chat window and the workbook stays untouched; Claude now edits the open file with full context.
solves_zh: 分析留在聊天窗口、表格却没动，现在 Claude 带着完整上下文直接改文件。
best_for: A model needs a new scenario column and you want it added in the workbook, not described in chat.
best_for_zh: 财务模型要加一列情景假设，希望直接写进表格而不是在对话里描述。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 2026-05-07 is the GA date for the Excel, PowerPoint and Word add-ins (Outlook public beta), the first day of the window. An earlier preview existed ('Advancing Claude for Excel and PowerPoint', 2026-03-11) but its first-availability post was not located, so the first public date may be earlier. Second source is not independent media. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在办公软件里的助手，与账本对同类插件的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://claude.com/resources/articles/collaborate-with-claude-across-excel-powerpoint-word-and-outlook
